download.maps: a 1024 px JPEG colour map and a 1024 px PNG normal map (a photogrammetry scan)

use: The pöddusteinn gift (surprise-items.js GIFT_ITEMS.trilobite): two instances, one on each of the pair's leaves, lying flat and leant toward the camera. +Y up, the origin on the ground in the middle of its footprint.

size.note: 1.7 m long, 0.6 m high; a trilobite fossil of about 14 cm, shown about 12 times its size

modifications: blender-gift.py: the imported node transform taken into the vertices, the seam vertices welded, decimated by collapse from 29,998 to 2,900 triangles (the colour map keeps the detail; the normal map is dropped), custom normals from the welded whole, scaled to 1.7 m and set on y = 0, the material rebuilt as plain metal-rough (colour map only, roughness 0.85), the colour map shrunk to 512 and written as WebP at quality 80. quantize-glb.mjs: positions 16-bit, normals 8-bit, texture coordinates 16-bit.
